# TikTok Video Views Analysis
Within this project, we are aiming to analyse a set of data collected from TikTok (video_views.csv). 

# Loading the Data for Analysis
```{r}
# Load the required package
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data file 
video_views <- read_csv("../data/raw/video_view.csv")
```

# Initial Summary of the Data
```{r}
# Number of rows and coloumns
dim(video_views)

# Variable names
names(video_views) 

# Summary of the variables
summary(video_views) 
```
